correctness.rationale: Conditional on a uniformly chosen leaf at depth d and cherry-membership J, S_next=S+d+2 and C_next=C+1-J. Introducing Q as total depths of cherry-member leaves gives E[Q_next|T]=(1-2/n)Q+2S/n+2. Multiplication before conditioning produces mixed E[S_next C_next|T]=(1-1/n)SC+(1+1/n)S+(2-4/n)C-Q/n+2. The solved marginal recurrences n>=3 imply the covariance recurrence g_(n+1)=(1-1/n)g_n-2/9 with g3=0 and the displayed exact expression; the n=2 initial exception and n=3 zero are handled. Independently implemented rational tip-splitting enumeration over the full ordered tree distribution through n=7 and checked every covariance, supplementing rather than replacing the all-n recurrence.

value.rationale: Sackin depth and cherries are standard complementary phylogenetic balance indices. Their exact all-n negative covariance and sharp sign transition calibrate joint behavior, improve on descriptive qualitative dependence, and are naturally relevant when both features are used to assess Yule-model tree balance.

final_claim: For standard uniformly tip-split Yule--Harding rooted binary trees, Cov(Sackin sum-of-leaf-depths, number of cherries)=0 at n=2 and -n/9+2/[3(n-1)] for every n>=3; zero n=3, negative n>=4, asymptotic -n/9.
limitations: The formula does not extend to birth-death models, nonuniform leaf-selection or time-weighted edges.
Covariance is not an assertion of complete negative dependence or joint distribution.
